summary_zh: T3 Code 是一个代理工具控制界面，可通过 iOS、Android 移动应用、Web 应用和 Electron 桌面应用控制本机已安装并登录的代理，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode、Google Antigravity 和 fx。
audience_zh: 适合已在本机安装并认证上述至少一个代理工具，希望通过手机、网页或桌面端远程操控这些代理的开发者；项目处于早期，需能接受缺陷。

evidence.quote: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ([iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824), [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code)), [web app](https
Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, and fx. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.
